automatic_rerun.policy: Use corrected-fixture outcomes for the two setup mismatches. Preserve the first Timed Write FAIL regardless of the unchanged diagnostic confirmation; no repeated retries to obtain green.

fixture_corrections.reason: Restore the simulated Wi-Fi in-test mode used by the earlier CSA15 PASS; actual initial commissioning stays on-network. SDK Wi-Fi accessors reject on-network as the in-test mode.

fixture_corrections.parameter_change: Use the existing verified C helper to encode the actual live host PIN, full discriminator, VID and PID; no host behavior change.

new_failure.observed: TH receives IM WriteResponse and fails the expired Timed Write assertion. Preceding delayed Timed Invoke receives StatusResponse/TIMEOUT.
new_failure.normative_reference: Core 1.6.1 section 8.7.2.3: an actually expired Timed Write requires StatusResponse/TIMEOUT and interaction termination.
new_failure.attribution: Open: capture actual peer/native packet times, response status and attribute side effects before claiming a native root cause.

observer_events.note: SDK file confirmed progress through subscription/heartbeat steps; observer timeout is not a DUT verdict.

memory_validation.reason: No native/runnable-host changes. All 362 current C/H inputs and the frozen native binary match the separately Memcheck- and sanitizer-tested CSA56/57 build.

limits: A complete isolated regression sweep, not endurance or certification.
Existing 18 automatic FAILs and 37 manual positions, including deferred DGGEN2.1, are not rerun.
No physical BLE/Wi-Fi, final-label, firmware, production-attestation, embedded RAM-fit or Home UI acceptance.
No native build or new native memory run this stage; previous exact-build evidence is identified explicitly.
next: CSA59: attribute the repeatable TC_IDM_5_2 Timed Write failure using actual packet times and side-effect readback; fix only a confirmed native defect, keeping the original test unchanged.
